penalties.details: The Company has received an Order from the Office of the Assessment Unit, Income Tax Department Raised a demand of Rs. 41,75,88,940/-. The issue pertains to disallowance of claim of Waiver of interest on working capital Loan in onetime settlement as non-taxable under section 41 of the Income tax Act,1961, pertaining to the assessment year 2018-2019.
penalties.impact: Considering the merits of the case, the Company intends to file appeal before the Appellate Authority within timelimit prescribed under the Law. The Company is hopeful of a favorable outcome thereof and does not expect the said Order to have any material financial impact on the Company.

timeline.summary: Aeroflex Industries Ltd’s **Ruthu Parampogi** (Mem. No. A60982) schedules virtual investor/analyst meet with Goldman Sachs India Supply Chain Resilience Group on **May 20, 2026, 10:00–11:00 AM** under SEBI’s Reg. 30(6).
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹125.84 Cr (+37.2% YoY), net profit ₹17.64 Cr (+57.1% YoY).
Aeroflex Industries Limited’s Board recommended a final dividend of ₹0.40 per equity share (20%) for FY2025-26, pending AGM approval on May 05, 2026.
Aeroflex Industries Ltd’s **Ruthu Parampogi** (Mem. No. A60982) schedules virtual analyst/investor meet on **May 19, 2026, 4:00–5:30 PM** under SEBI Listing Regulations.
Italica Global F.Z.C reported holding 74,54,830 shares with zero encumbrance as of March 31, 2026.
Aeroflex Industries submitted annual promoter encumbrance disclosures under Regulation 31(4) reporting zero pledged shares for FY26.
Board approved ₹202 Cr phased capex across SS Hose & Braiding and Skid Assemblies Divisions completion targeted by March 2028.
Aeroflex Industries Limited secures Indian patent for automated 3D braided hose modeling technology
Aeroflex Industries Limited scheduled an Analyst/Investor Meet and Earnings Call with **Mr. Asad Daud (MD)** on October 29, 2026, at 11:00 AM IST.
Aeroflex Industries approved the amalgamation of wholly owned subsidiary Hyd-Air Engineering and reported Q2FY27 revenue of ₹207 Cr.
